Screenshot
[PREVIEW LinSql] The vote count on the submission is incorrect when a user has voted on it, and is correct otherwise. Is there any specific reason on this behavior?

This is the same on Voat. If you upvote a post the "net value" that is shown is not actually a net value; it just shows you the total number of upvotes given to the post. Likewise, if you downvote a post the "net value" is not a net value; it just shows you the total number of downvotes on the post.

This is probably expected behaviour / known, and I'm not sure if there is a reason for this or what, but I'll flair as DISCUSSION. I think others have suggested changing this in the past.
